fact: StartupBeat says Sème City, launched in 2017 with World Bank backing as a campus for research and startup incubation, runs the Next Impact scheme giving 18-35 year olds up to CFA 30 million per project and six months of coaching.
StartupBeat says EtriLabs, a startup incubator, was created in 2009 in Benin; no programme or cohort is described.

The L'Envol incubator in Abomey-Calavi hosts the Cyber Incub programme, which has given ten cybersecurity startup teams intensive support since November 2025, run by Adpme and Asin with LuxDev backing.
La Nation says the Cyber Incub cybersecurity incubator was officially launched by the state agencies Asin, Adpme and Cnin, with no programme or cohort stated.
